description: Source code for Würth Elektronic WSEN-ITDS 3-axis accelerometer sensor driver, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and attribute setting functions.

methods.name: itds_get_odr_for_index
methods.description: Retrieves the output data rate (ODR) and its master frequency based on index and operating mode.

methods.name: itds_accl_odr_set
methods.description: Sets the accelerometer output data rate based on desired frequency and master frequency.

methods.name: itds_accl_range_set
methods.description: Configures the accelerometer measurement range and sensitivity scale.

methods.name: itds_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as full scale and sampling frequency.

methods.name: itds_fetch_temperature
methods.description: Fetches temperature data from the sensor.

methods.name: itds_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data for specified channels.

methods.name: itds_accl_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves accelerometer channel data and converts to sensor_value.

methods.name: itds_temp_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves temperature channel data and converts to sensor_value.

methods.name: itds_channel_get
methods.description: Gets data for specified sensor channel.

methods.name: itds_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, configures default settings, and verifies device ID.
